question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Victorious
solution:
The correct answer is "**Champion."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• "**Victorious**" means having won a battle or competition, successful.(विजयी)

 
 
• Example: The Indian cricket team emerged victorious in the World Cup final.​
 
 
 
• "**Champion**" is a person or team who has won a competition or championship.(हिमायती)
 
 
• Example: He is a former chess champion.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the word "champion" is the synonym of the word "victorious."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In option 2, **Unsuccessful**, means not achieving the desired outcome or not successful.(असफल)
 
• In option 3,** Failing**, means not succeeding or falling short of expectations.(असफलता)
 
• In option 4,** Losing,** means not winning or being defeated.(हार)
